app.name: Shakti Prime
app.tagline: One place to run Shakti's leads, sales, stock, projects and payments.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use your work email and the password you chose.

setPassword.title: Choose your password
setPassword.intro: This password is yours alone. Use at least 12 characters; a short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
setPassword.done: Your password is saved. You can sign in now.

twoFactor.enrolIntro: Your role needs a second check at sign-in. Install an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator on your phone, then confirm your password to begin.
twoFactor.scanTitle: Scan this with your authenticator app
twoFactor.scanIntro: Open the app, choose “Add account” and scan the square. If the camera doesn't work, type the key below by hand.
twoFactor.backupIntro: If you lose your phone, sign in with one of these codes. Each code works only once. Write them down or save them somewhere private.
twoFactor.verifyTitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app
twoFactor.verifyIntro: Open the app on your phone and type the 6-digit code shown for Shakti Prime.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.done: Your password is changed. Other devices are signed out.

setPassword.subject: Your Shakti Prime sign-in
setPassword.body:
Hello {name},

Your Shakti Prime access is ready. Open this link to choose your password:
{url}

The link works for one day. If you didn't expect this email, you can ignore it.

Shakti Prime

resetPassword.subject: Choose a new Shakti Prime password
resetPassword.body:
Hello {name},

Open this link to choose a new password for Shakti Prime:
{url}

The link works for one hour, and only the newest link works. If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays as it is.

Shakti Prime

signInAttempts.subject: Someone tried to sign in to your Shakti Prime account
signInAttempts.body:
Hello {name},

Someone has entered a wrong password for your Shakti Prime account several times. If it was you, there is nothing to do. If it wasn't, tell your manager today and change your password from the home screen.

Shakti Prime

design.title: Design preview
design.intro: Every colour, text size and control in the light and dark themes. Each colour shows how readable it is on a card: text needs 4.5 or more, lines and icons need 3 or more.
